protocol.limits: Each child loads the staged project over the stock HOL core. The supervisor applies a batch-level deadline.
protocol.run: Two cold references and one static batch started together. The batch ran one child at a time.
protocol.scope: One conjunction fixture. The cold comparisons cover a successful leaf edit and a rejected tactic.
protocol.timer: Cold and batch wall time exclude staging and lock validation. Child time covers fork through wait.
protocol.trace: A raised tactic emits no open-goal rows. The proof session keeps the previous state.
protocol.verification: The pilot times native goal observations. Independent proof verification is recorded in evidence/hol-branches.json.

remaining_checks: Revalidate the lock and coordinator identity before every request and retire a stale parent.
Test imported project modules, cross-task namespace parity and private per-request output channels.
Enforce each child deadline, cancellation, and resource budget and reap descendants on failure.
